title: Second Eyes run config, format v1
description: One per run, in runs/<run ID>/config.yaml. Created by 'python tools/runs.py new', checked by 'python tools/runs.py check'. Rules: runs/README.md.

run_id.description: YYYYMMDD_<phase>_r<NNN>; the run folder has the same name.

phase.description: A phase ID from the research proposal.

created.description: Local time with UTC offset, in quotes, e.g. "2026-10-01T14:03:22+02:00".

purpose.description: One non-empty line: why this run exists.

operator.description: One non-empty line: who ran it.

git_commit.description: Full commit hash of the repository when the run was created.

git_dirty.description: true if the repository had uncommitted changes, including new files, when the run was created. Files ignored by .gitignore don't count.

model_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the model file (64 lowercase hex characters), or null.

prompt_version.description: Version of the prompt template, or null.

schema_version.description: Version of the model's output/scene schema (proposal section 6.2), or null.
